props.description: A single cracked figure sits in a dim room. From one side, hands rush in pouring grey cement over the fracture, trying to seal it — the cement hardens and dims the figure. From the other side, a second presence simply sits down beside, no hands, no fixing, and a soft warm light grows around both. The two impulses — cement versus presence — diverge visually so the viewer feels the difference between fixing and witnessing.

script: the loneliness of having your pain redirected.
